info.synopsis: Un uomo assetato si avvicina a un distributore automatico. In quell'istante un camion fuori controllo incidentalmente lo urta facendolo cadere. episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: After his untimely death, our unlikely hero finds himself in another world, reincarnated as a vending machine. Now his life revolves around selling things to people, but he's stuck in the middle of nowhere with no sign of any customers.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
